Scholarship Name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
Short Description: Merit-based scholarship for economically weaker Class 9 students entering secondary education.
Detailed Description: The NMMSS is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Education, GoI. It awards Rs. 1,000 per month (Rs. 12,000 per year) to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at the secondary level. Students must qualify a state-level selection test. Implemented through NSP.
Provider / Offering Body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not more than Rs. 3,50,000/- per annum
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Must study in Class 8 in Govt./Govt.-aided/local body school; must qualify NMMSS selection test
Scholarship Amount: Rs. 12,000 per annum (Rs. 1,000/month)
Renewal Conditions: Renewal subject to promotion to next class, minimum 50% marks, 75% attendance
Required Documents: Income certificate, marksheet of Class 7, bank passbook, Aadhaar card, institute verification form, residential certificate
Selection Process: State-level selection test; merit list prepared by State/UT
Notes / Special Instructions: Apply through NSP after qualifying state-level NMMSS exam. Exam typically held in November-December.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Scholarship Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
Short Description: Financial support for SC students in Classes 9-10 to reduce dropout rate at the secondary stage.
Detailed Description: Centrally sponsored scheme by Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for SC students in Classes 9 and 10. Provides maintenance allowance and ad-hoc grant to minimize dropout during the transition from elementary to secondary education. Implemented through NSP.
Provider / Offering Body: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not more than Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Must belong to Scheduled Caste; studying in a recognized school; regular attendance
Scholarship Amount: Rs. 3500 per year for day scholars; 7000 per year for hostelers; Rs. 8000/year(  for class 3 to 10) hosteller
Renewal Conditions: Renewal subject to promotion to next class with minimum attendance
Required Documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, marksheet, fee receipt, bank passbook, Aadhaar card, institute verification form
Selection Process: Apply through NSP; verified by institute and state/district authorities
Notes / Special Instructions: Income ceiling Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum. Both fresh and renewal applications accepted through NSP.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Scholarship Name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
Short Description: Merit-based scholarship for Class 12 toppers (top 20%) pursuing higher education in recognized institutions.
Detailed Description: Merit-based scheme by Ministry of Education providing financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing higher studies. 82,000 scholarships awarded annually (50% reserved for girls). Awarded on the basis of Class 12 board results.
Provider / Offering Body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
Eligibility - Min. Marks: Minimum 80% marks in Class 12; top 20% of respective board
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not more than Rs. 4,50,000/- per annum (gross)
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Indian citizen; passed Class 12 from recognized board; pursuing regular full-time course in recognized institution; not availing any other scholarship (except same scheme)
Scholarship Amount: Rs. 10,000/year for first 3 years; Rs. 20,000/year for 4th and 5th year (professional courses)
Renewal Conditions: Renewal subject to minimum 50% marks in annual exam and 75% attendance
Required Documents: Class 12 marksheet, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank passbook, institute verification form, fee receipt, bonafide certificate
Selection Process: Based on Class 12 board merit list; verified through NSP
Notes / Special Instructions: Covers graduate/postgraduate/professional courses. Students can apply for one merit + one or more welfare schemes through NSP.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Scholarship Name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
Short Description: Comprehensive financial support for SC students pursuing post-matric studies to improve gross enrollment ratio.
Detailed Description: Centrally sponsored scheme by MoSJE providing maintenance allowance and full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees to SC students pursuing post-matric courses (Class 11 onwards through PhD). One of the largest welfare schemes of GoI, implemented through NSP.
Provider / Offering Body: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not more than Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Must belong to SC; enrolled in recognized post-matric course; regular attendance; not availing any other scholarship for same purpose
Scholarship Amount: Full maintenance allowance (Rs. 550-1,200/month hostellers, Rs. 230-550/month day scholars); reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees; additional allowances for disabled students
Renewal Conditions: Renewal subject to passing with minimum marks and 75% attendance; promotion to next class
Required Documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, marksheet, fee receipt, bank passbook, Aadhaar card, institute verification form, disability certificate (if applicable)
Selection Process: Apply through NSP; verified by institute nodal officer and state/district authorities
Coverage: Tuition Fee, Maintenance Allowance, Books, Hostel
Notes / Special Instructions: Income ceiling Rs. 2.50 lakh/annum. Covers Class 11 to PhD level. One of the largest centrally sponsored scholarship schemes.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Scholarship Name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
Short Description: Prestigious doctoral research fellowship for PhD scholars in premier institutions with generous monthly stipend and research grant.
Detailed Description: PMRF is a flagship scheme of MoE for doctoral research in cutting-edge science and technology. Fellows receive Rs. 70,000/month (Year 1-2), Rs. 75,000/month (Year 3), Rs. 80,000/month (Year 4-5), plus Rs. 2 lakh/year research grant. Available in IITs, IISc, IISERs, and other premier institutes. Applications called twice a year (July and January cycles).
Provider / Offering Body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
Eligibility - Course Level: PhD scholars meeting PMRF academic and institutional eligibility requirements.
Eligibility - Min. Marks: Minimum 8.0 CGPA (or equivalent) in UG/PG from recognized institute; or qualified GATE/NET with valid score
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not specified (merit-based; institutional nomination required)
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Must be Indian citizen; admitted/enrolled in PhD at a PMRF-granting institute; within 5 years of qualifying degree; institute must nominate the candidate
Scholarship Amount: Rs. 70,000/month (Yr 1-2), Rs. 75,000/month (Yr 3), Rs. 80,000/month (Yr 4-5) + Rs. 2,00,000/year research grant
Renewable?: Yes (for 5 years or till PhD completion)
Renewal Conditions: Annual review by institute; continuation based on satisfactory research progress
Application Deadline: Cycle-specific; not a generic annual July deadline. Check the official PMRF calendar/announcement.
Required Documents: CGPA/academic transcripts, GATE/NET scorecard, research proposal, institute nomination letter, NOC, Aadhaar card, bank details
Selection Process: Two routes: (1) Direct entry via institute nomination with qualifying exam (GATE/NET) + interview, (2) Lateral entry for existing PhD scholars. Selection by PMRF committee.
Notes / Special Instructions: May 2026 cycle closed on 15 July 2026. Next cycle expected January/February 2027. Guidelines available on primeministerfellowshipscheme.in.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Detailed Description: UGC NET JRF is a national-level fellowship awarded through the UGC NET examination conducted by NTA. JRF qualified candidates receive Rs. 37,000/month for the first 2 years (JRF) and Rs. 42,000/month thereafter (SRF) for up to 5 years or till PhD completion. Includes Rs. 10,000/year contingency grant. For Humanities, Social Sciences, and selected Science subjects.
Provider / Offering Body: University Grants Commission (UGC) / NTA
Eligibility - Min. Marks: Qualify UGC NET with JRF rank
Eligibility - Income Ceiling: Not specified (merit-based; JRF qualification required)
Eligibility - Other Criteria: Must qualify UGC NET exam with JRF rank; enrolled or enrolling in M.Phil/PhD at a UGC-recognized university; age not more than 30 years (relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women)
Scholarship Amount: Rs. 37,000/month (JRF, 2 years); Rs. 42,000/month (SRF, remaining period) + Rs. 10,000/year contingency
Renewable?: Yes (for 5 years or till PhD completion)
Renewal Conditions: Annual review by university; continuation based on satisfactory research progress
Application Start Date: Rolling (UGC NET conducted twice a year; Dec 2025 results declared Apr 2026; June 2026 exam upcoming)
Required Documents: UGC NET scorecard, JRF award letter, university admission/enrollment proof, Aadhaar card, bank details, NOC from employer (if applicable)
Selection Process: Qualify UGC NET with JRF rank; get fellowship activated through university
Number of Slots (Approx.): ~3,000-4,000 per cycle (JRF slots vary by subject)
Notes / Special Instructions: Fellowship is activated through the university after NET-JRF qualification. Two exam cycles per year (June and December). HRA as per norms. SRF promotion after 2 years.
Verification Notes: Verify current deadline/status on the official provider portal before publication.

Renewal Conditions: Annual review; SRF promotion after 2 years
Required Documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, PG marksheet, PhD enrollment proof, NET-JRF scorecard (if applicable), Aadhaar card, bank details, research proposal
Selection Process: 75% through UGC NET-JRF; 25% through direct selection by UGC; interview for direct selection
